Metadata.title: TEOS IT — Mobile, web and AI development studio
Metadata.description: TEOS IT designs, builds and launches React Native apps, web platforms and AI features — from the first sketch to the App Store.

Footer.tagline: Mobile, web and AI development studio from Novi Sad, Serbia.

hero.title: Mobile apps and web products, built by the people you talk to.
hero.lead: TEOS IT designs, builds and launches React Native apps, web platforms and AI features — from the first sketch to the App Store. No account managers, no hand-offs.

services.title: One team for the app, the web and everything behind them.

mobile.label: Mobile
mobile.title: Mobile apps
mobile.body: iOS and Android from one React Native codebase. We handle the store release, payments and push notifications too.

web.label: Web
web.title: Web development
web.body: Fast websites, dashboards and SaaS platforms on Next.js and React — built to rank and easy to grow.

backend.label: Backend
backend.title: Backend & APIs
backend.body: Databases, auth and APIs on Node.js, Supabase and Postgres. Secure by default, ready for real traffic.

ai.label: AI
ai.title: AI development
ai.body: LLM features, assistants and automations built into your product — useful, measurable, not a demo.

design.label: Design
design.title: UI/UX design
design.body: User flows, interfaces and design systems in Figma, tested before a line of code is written.

outsourcing.label: Team
outsourcing.title: Outsourcing
outsourcing.body: Senior React Native and web engineers who join your team, your stand-ups and your workflow.

discovery.title: Discovery
discovery.body: We map your goals, users and constraints, then agree on scope and budget.

design.title: Design
design.body: Flows and screens in Figma, validated with you before we build.

build.title: Build
build.body: Short cycles with a working preview build every week.

ship.title: Ship
ship.body: Store release, launch, monitoring — and we stay for what comes next.

founder.title: “You talk to the person who writes your code.”
founder.body: I'm Petro, founder of TEOS IT. I've spent the last years leading React Native teams and shipping apps for clients in Germany and Switzerland. I'm on every project — from the first call to the store release.
founder.photoAlt: Petro Arva, founder of TEOS IT

points.ownership: You own all code and designs

amplitude.quote: “TEOS IT took our app from a rough concept to a polished product in the stores faster than we thought possible. They didn’t just execute tickets — they pushed back on the right things, owned the architecture and treated every screen like their own product.”
amplitude.author: Maximilian Frederic Jacob, CEO at Amplitude Holding GmbH

checkSolar.quote: “We needed a fast, trustworthy platform that turns a complicated decision into five minutes of work. TEOS IT delivered a clean, performant web app and stayed pragmatic about scope the whole way through. Sharp communication, solid code, shipped on time.”
checkSolar.author: Tim Fux, CTO at Fux Marketing OÜ

cta.title: Have an app or product in mind?
cta.body: Tell us where you are. In a free 30-minute call we'll tell you honestly what it takes — time, cost and the best stack for it.
